messages.subject: Error in the fsr function
parts:
Hi, I have got an error in the lavaan:::fsr function. If I run an example described here, I got this error message: 

> fit <- lavaan:::fsr(model, data = PoliticalDemocracy, fsr.method = "Skrondal-Laake")
Error in (function (..., row.names = NULL, check.rows = FALSE, check.names = TRUE,  : 
  arguments imply differing number of rows: 6, 8, 4

Is it here some solution to fix the problem?
Thank you!
Hynek
